original_test_intent: Validate correct reporting and recovery of one PCIe uncorrectable non-fatal Completion Timeout on an approved request path, with target-correlated AER evidence and continued host operation.
original_method: Remain blocked now. Future method maps requester, completer, root port and transaction type; records timeout-range/AER state and device workload; suppresses or delays one approved completion using a vendor injector; correlates the exact request to fresh Completion Timeout status; then verifies non-fatal function recovery, data integrity and stable host/link state.
manual_activity: The PCIe/device owner selects a disposable transaction and exact requester/completer path, approves the non-fatal timeout stimulus, supervises recovery and validates device data integrity.
required_inputs: Pinned NVIDIA PCIe AER injector/spec/version/checksum and supported topology/firmware/OS
Requester/completer/root-port/slot/BDF path, transaction type and safe device workload
Exact completion suppression/delay mechanism, timeout-range encoding and stimulus command
Expected Completion Timeout uncorrectable status, severity-bit interpretation, root reporting and OS handling deadline
Approved function-level reset/driver recovery versus forbidden host reset, plus link and data-integrity criteria
Independent OOB/console recovery, abort thresholds, clear policy and restoration
safety_requirements: Do not run until the transaction, non-fatal severity and recovery contract are approved
Use an isolated device/workload and disposable verified data with independent console/OOB
Baseline timeout settings, AER status/masks/severity, topology, driver, I/O and recovery capabilities

Preserve transaction/AER/reset evidence before approved recovery and verify data plus device state

Do not alter timeout ranges/masks, suppress completions, inject, reset function/link/host, clear, recover, retry or decide result
engineer_actions: Author the Completion Timeout procedure and Criteria
Approve requester/completer transaction, severity and permitted recovery action
Supervise one stimulus and function recovery
Validate data integrity and issue verdict

review_improvement: Adds transaction correlation, severity-bit verification, permitted function recovery and data-integrity gates unique to Completion Timeout.
independent_technical_reasoning: A completion timeout occurs when a requester does not receive a completion within its configured range; it is not the replay timer used for link reliability. The testcase must identify both transaction endpoints and show the platform classified the uncorrectable event as non-fatal while recovering only the affected function. With no transaction or Criteria, setting a status bit would not preserve the original intent.
